question: In a certain code language, 'CAUTION' is written as 'NOITCAU'. How will 'FOREVER' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'CAUTION' is written as 'NOITCAU',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1adfd2f8d6f606fba2a584b8a9a0776b717e82faddba3f83128a9d8ff2f131f4.png] 

Similarly, for 'FOREVER'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/31b4e4a19c98f61a70d426c707239197833efde17780b5211977e3eb3ddbfb4d.png] 

So, 'FOREVER' will be written as 'REVEFOR'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
